monetization.noteEs: Compra única (~$35 USD). La tienda in-game vende solo cosméticos y pestañas extra de stash; no hay battle pass ni power buyable. La expansión Orobyss se anunció como actualización gratuita para quienes ya compraron el juego antes de su lanzamiento. Eleventh Hour Games tiene un manifiesto explícito contra MTX agresivo, herencia que mantuvieron post-adquisición por KRAFTON en 2025.
monetization.noteEn: One-time purchase (~$35 USD). The in-game store sells only cosmetics and extra stash tabs; no battle pass and no buyable power. The Orobyss expansion was announced as a free update for everyone who owned the game before its launch. Eleventh Hour Games has an explicit manifesto against aggressive MTX, a stance they kept after the KRAFTON acquisition in 2025.
